correctness.rationale: The exact graph predicate exhausts all 32768 labeled six-vertex graphs, yielding 4503 faces including the empty face; signed invariant orbit chains are constructed for each of 11 conjugacy classes. The included standalone program checks every boundary square and computes ranks over primes 2147483647 and 1000000007, reproducing all cyclic invariant Betti numbers. The known integral sphere-wedge homotopy theorem ensures homology freeness; prime-to-group-order averaging and localization make modular invariant ranks equal rational invariant dimensions. Power-average equations determine all graded characters, a second signed Lefschetz calculation verifies the differences in every class, and an independently computed Specht table passes orthogonality and gives nonnegative multiplicities with exact total dimensions. Quotient rational acyclicity follows from the absence of trivial and sign constituents and finite-group rational transfer. This is one finite exact result, not a conjectural extrapolation.

value.rationale: The six-vertex bounded-domination graph complex was explicitly distinguished in the original literature and is known to have mixed-dimensional sphere-wedge homotopy. Its natural full vertex-relabeling symmetry representation is a structurally motivated new invariant invisible from sphere counts: every one of the nine nonlinear S6 irreducibles appears in degree four, only three appear in degree five, and neither degree contains global or alternating-group invariant classes. A complete exact graded character is useful for equivariant combinatorial topology and natural symmetry quotients, without claiming an all-parameter theorem.
